items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다...콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Gucci cut the price of its Mercato small tote in Korea from 4.45 million won to 3.5 million won (-21.3%), the first markdown in over a decade; Boucheron and Van Cleef & Arpels followed with smaller cuts. Article frames this as the biggest luxury markdown wave since Chanel's 2015 cuts, driven by shrinking middle-class luxury spending.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어졌어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Covers consumer backlash after Gucci's price cuts (Padlock crystal bag down ~30% in France; Mercato tote down 21.3% in Korea) left recent buyers feeling cheated, with no compensation offered. Quotes an online luxury community member regretting their purchase. Also notes Gucci quietly raised prices on other items (Marmont mini shoulder bag +9.5%) in late October without notice.

items.title: 구찌는 30% 내렸는데, 망설이는 루이비통...'가격' 딜레마에 빠진 명품업계
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's aggressive 30% price cuts with Louis Vuitton's reluctance to discount, framing both brands' middle-class customer erosion (half of combined sales from consumers spending $2,000-3,000/year) as the structural driver.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데...루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Reports on Gucci breaking the luxury industry taboo of never discounting, cutting bag prices up to 30% amid prolonged downturn, while Louis Vuitton hesitates over brand equity concerns.

items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"...중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: Analyzes how middle-class consumers withdrawing from luxury spending has hit both Louis Vuitton and Gucci, citing declining store traffic and the structural shift away from aspirational buying as the shared root cause.

items.source: FashionNetwork / nss magazine (via BusinessToday Malaysia translation feed, syndicated NEA angle)
items.title: Gucci Cruise 2028 in Shanghai: show on May 17, 2027 with Demna
items.summary: Gucci announced Demna's Cruise 2028 show will be staged in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking his first Asia runway show as creative director and the 30th anniversary of Gucci's first China boutique. Positioned as part of the brand's push to reconnect with Chinese consumers after Kering CEO Luca de Meo acknowledged Gucci had become disconnected from them.

items.source: Weibo (official Gucci China account + reaction thread)
items.title: 古驰2028早春大秀定档上海，门票能买到吗？
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread on Gucci's Shanghai Cruise 2028 show announcement; users speculate about celebrity guest list (Ningning, Ni Ni, Park Bo-gum most requested) and whether the show will feature China-specific cultural elements. Reflects genuine fan engagement volume around the announcement.

items.title: 古驰关掉上海唯一旗舰店，14个月后把2028早春秀定回上海：秀能拉回人，价签得自己撑住
items.summary: Consumer community post critically juxtaposing Gucci's March 2026 closure of its last Shanghai flagship (iapm) with the newly announced 2028 Cruise show in the same city. Author argues a glamorous show cannot restore consumer trust when prior price hikes (~21% 2020-2023) followed by discounts (~30%) have damaged price credibility; questions whether shoppers will buy at full price post-show or keep waiting for markdowns.

items.title: 古驰有款包降了三成，二手回收只剩三到六成：现在买Gucci，先分清「省下的钱」和「卖得掉的钱」
items.summary: Resale-market community post explaining that after Gucci's September-November retail price cuts (Mercato tote and GG Marmont bucket down ~30%), secondhand recovery values fell in tandem rather than improving — buyers typically recoup only 30-60% of retail. Frames Gucci bags as poor investment vehicles regardless of markdowns, a recurring theme in Chinese resale communities.

items.title: Gucci的Padlock手袋为什么会降价？
items.summary: Weibo explainer/discussion thread on why Gucci cut the Padlock crystal bag price ~30% (3,500 euro to 2,450 euro) in France, tying it to 13 consecutive quarters of sales decline and eroding middle-income shopper visits; comments include consumers calculating losses on recent purchases.

items.source: theqoo (via Pannchoa aggregation of theqoo thread)
items.title: [theqoo] Park Bo-gum's face during Gucci's LACMA gala event
items.summary: Korean community thread (theqoo) reacting to Park Bo-gum's first public outing as Gucci global ambassador at the LACMA Art+Film Gala on Nov 7. Overwhelmingly positive comments on his styling and look; one commenter notes surprise at his brand switch from a previous luxury partner, indicating audience is tracking ambassador moves closely.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라...제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Reports Gucci ambassadors Park Bo-gum and aespa's Ningning attending the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala on Nov 9, 2026 red carpet, described as commanding attention with their styling; activation/PR coverage.

items.title: グッチ、「GucciCore」コレクションのローンチイベントに山田涼介ら豪華セレブリティが集結
items.summary: Gucci held the GucciCore (2027 Cruise) collection launch event at Gucci Aoyama on Nov 16, 2026, attended by 15 Japanese celebrities including Friend-of-House Yamada Ryosuke, with a live performance by hip-hop artist Kohjiya. Framed as the fourth chapter of Demna's reinterpretation of Gucci heritage, emphasizing wearability.

items.source: Yahoo! News Japan (via Sports Bull / All About aggregation)
items.title: 「世界一GUCCIが似合う」山田涼介、グッチコーデのイケメンショットに反響「存在がハイブラ！」
items.summary: Fan reaction roundup to Yamada Ryosuke's GucciCore event appearance, aggregating social comments like "存在がハイブラ" (he himself is the luxury brand) and "最強すぎる." Reflects strong organic fan engagement volume around the Japan ambassador activation, though skews promotional/fan-service in tone.

items.title: 【Gucci】「GucciCore」のローンチイベントにて、Kohjiyaがライブパフォーマンスを披露
items.summary: Official Kering Japan press release confirming Kohjiya's live performance at the GucciCore launch event in Aoyama; official brand-owned source, counted as activation/official coverage rather than independent public opinion.

items.source: WWD Japan (via fashion-shift.com citing WWDJ data)
items.title: グッチ、売上6%減で苦戦続く。デムナ起用でも回復は道半ば
items.summary: Reports Gucci's Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) comparable sales fell 6%, revenue EUR 1.291 billion, marking 11 consecutive quarters of decline despite Demna's appointment; Kering plans to close at least 125 net stores group-wide for the year and cut EUR 1 billion in inventory, concentrating remaining stores on flagship locations.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？2026文艺复兴式复苏3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Explainer article aggregating Gucci's recent news: Demna's Primavera debut referencing Botticelli's Spring, fall-winter campaign with Xiao Zhan and Ning Yizhuo reviving 1990s tailoring, alongside continued store closures (105 net in nine months, target raised to 125) and structural 30-40% price cuts on core handbags. Balanced framing mixing creative revival narrative with business distress facts.

items.title: 古驰包二手能卖多少钱？2026保值率实测：经典款5-6折，网红款腰斩
items.summary: Weibo resale-value explainer thread reporting 2026 secondhand recovery rates for Gucci bags: classic styles (1955 Horsebit) hold ~50-60% of retail, while trend-driven styles have lost roughly half their value, reflecting weakening brand resale confidence among Chinese secondhand buyers/sellers.

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 구찌 컬렉션, 패션 전문가들의 반응?
items.summary: Fashion-industry expert reactions to Demna's debut Gucci collection ('La Famiglia'); included for context on ongoing critical/skeptical commentary track around Demna's creative direction that continues to recur in Korean trade press discussion threads.

items.title: 年内最後のラッキーデーに向けて【グッチ】が新作スモールレザーグッズを発売。日本限定デザインも！
items.summary: Product-launch coverage: Gucci releasing new small leather goods including Japan-exclusive designs timed to the year's final 'lucky day' shopping occasion (Dec 16, 2026). Standard activation/PR coverage.

items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业处于什么地位？3个维度说清准一线王者的攻防战
items.summary: Weibo explainer debating Gucci's current standing in the luxury hierarchy amid prolonged sales decline, framing it as a 'quasi-first-tier' brand fighting to defend position against Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Hermès and fast-rising Loewe/Miu Miu. Representative of ongoing Chinese social discourse questioning Gucci's trajectory.

items.title: 구찌, 뎀나가 직접 촬영한 2026 프리폴 컬렉션 룩북 공개
items.summary: Older lookbook coverage retained only as background context for Demna-era creative direction continuity; not counted toward freshness-weighted items (outside 14-day window), included solely to document brand aliasing/mentions.

notes: Critical-angle searches (price hikes/cuts, backlash, resale depreciation, store closures, analyst skepticism) surfaced substantial material in NEA, primarily via Korean economic press (price-cut backlash) and Chinese Weibo/SMZDM community threads (resale value erosion, Shanghai flagship closure vs. new show skepticism). 5ch/Naver Cafe/Naver Blog/Douyin/Xiaohongshu direct site-scoped searches did not surface distinct, attributable dated items beyond generic product-review content (admission standard not met); DC Inside returned only evergreen product threads, not dated opinion content, so excluded from item pool despite being checked.
